name: Discover project context for meeting preparation
query: Prepare a 30-minute Orbit launch readiness agenda and save it in the project meeting area. Carry forward any open actions from the last review.

search_routes.intent: Find the Orbit project or launch readiness materials

results.title: Orbit sales campaign
results.snippet: Sales collateral; not the launch project.

search_routes.intent: Find the current Orbit last review or project meeting area

sources.https://notion.so/orbit-archive: Archived prototype. Launch completed in 2024. Not the current project.
sources.https://notion.so/orbit-project: Current launch target: October 20, 2026. Open blocker: rollback rehearsal. Most recent review: https://notion.so/orbit-review. Meeting area: https://notion.so/orbit-meetings.
sources.https://notion.so/orbit-sales: Campaign assets only; no readiness decisions.
sources.https://notion.so/orbit-review: October 2 review: Maya owns the rollback rehearsal, still open. Lee completed the alert audit. A go/no-go decision is pending.

success_criteria: Finds the current Orbit project and fetches the project and last review instead of using the archived launch.
Carries forward Maya's open rehearsal action and the pending go/no-go decision; does not reopen Lee's completed audit.
Creates one agenda under the discovered Orbit meeting parent with time allocations totaling at most 30 minutes.
Cites the project and review where needed and returns the created agenda link.
Does not create an unrequested pre-read, task pages, or attendee notifications.
